what.text: This page follows refugees from Iraq living in the Netherlands, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4193 Iraqi refugees in the Netherlands, 1.5% of all refugees from Iraq.
Germany hosts the most Iraqi refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Türkiye and France.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Iraq in periods from 1987 to 2025, with IS, al-Mahdi Army and Ansar al-Islam among the opponents since 2004.
It also records armed conflict over Kurdistan territory in some years up to 1996.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 1795 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 28640, at the end of 2003; the main years of displacement in the data are 1997 to 2014.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Netherlands.
These are year-end totals for the Netherlands only, reported to UNHCR.
